patch.summary: Update account-level user settings (in-app messages, contact details, pickup branch).
patch.description:
Partially updates the signed-in user's account. Every field is optional; only the fields present in the body are changed.

- `receiveMessagesInApp` toggles in-app messages. When `true`, the user is created in the BFF database (required before registering a device for push) and the `App:Messages` notification protocol is enabled on their FBS patron; when `false`, the protocol is removed. Login now subscribes automatically, so this is retained mainly for backwards compatibility and opt-out.
- `email` ({ address, receiveNotification? }) / `phone` ({ number, receiveNotification? }) overwrite the patron's contact details (a single entry each). An omitted field leaves that channel untouched, an explicit `null` clears it; when present, `receiveNotification` defaults to false (opt-in required).
- `preferredPickupBranchId` sets the preferred pickup branch. Valid branches must have `isValidForPickup: true`

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for a BFF token (OAuth2 token endpoint).
post.description: OAuth2-shaped: swaps an Adgangsplatformen authorization code for a BFF-issued JWT (embedding the AP access token) plus the AP refresh token. Accepts a form-urlencoded, snake_case body; a `grant_type` field is accepted and ignored. `deviceId` and `appType` are taken from the client-hint headers. For Adgangsplatformen logins this also runs the login lifecycle: the user is provisioned in the BFF database and subscribed to in-app notifications on their FBS patron (best-effort — never blocks login).

post.summary: Webhook receiver for Cicero patron notifications.
post.description:
Accepts an incoming Cicero notification, persists it as an in-app message, and dispatches an FCM push to each device the recipient has registered (best-effort).

The shared secret is **per agency** and is verified against the top-level `agency` in the payload, so an agency we do not know is rejected as 401 — this endpoint cannot be used to probe which agencies exist.

Behavior:
- `notification.messageType` not on the configured allow-list → silently acknowledged (202).
- Top-level `agency` (e.g. `DK-710100`) must match `DK-NNNNNN` and exist in our agency table.
- `patronInformation.identifier.value` must be present; it is used as the user id (hashed).

Errors follow Cicero’s `{ correlationId?, message? }` shape (see `CiceroNotificationExceptionResponse`), except 401, which the spec builder replaces with a generic `Authentication required` for every guarded route. `correlationId` is read from the `x-correlation-id` request header when present, otherwise a fresh UUID is generated.

202.description: Webhook received; processed asynchronously if handled

400.description: Malformed offer data, or the organization carries no municipality id

404.description: The organization resolved to no agency we hold

post.description: Accepts a WDB webhook envelope (`{ type, action, data }`). Handles type: `"reservation_offer"` with any `action` that has `data.status = "offered"` and `data.origin_org_type = "municipality"`; other combinations are acknowledged but ignored.

200.description: Return the list of recommended works based on the given work.

get.summary: Get work recommendations.
get.description: Up to 10 works, recommended by FBI from this work’s best representation. A work with no record behind it gets an empty list rather than an error.

parameters.name: x-installation-id

200.description: Return the reviews for the work.

get.summary: Get reviews for a specific work.
get.description: Covers both the library reviews FBI serves inline and the licensed (Infomedia) ones, which are resolved one by one and merged in.

PhoneNumber.description: A contact phone number, with optional international country code.

DateTime.description: An instant in time, ISO 8601 in UTC. Always ends in `Z` — never a local offset.

municipalityLogoUrl.description: Null when the library has not configured a logo in FB-CMS, or when its FB-CMS instance does not expose brand settings yet. Clients must supply their own fallback.

informationUrl.description: The library's page explaining where and how to pay fees and replacement costs.

paymentUrl.description: Link to the library's payment portal.

paymentButtonLabel.description: Library-authored label for the payment portal link. Clients must supply their own fallback copy.

pinLength.description: Minimum pincode length; named pinLength for backward compatibility.

BranchId.description: The ISIL id of a branch.

recordId.description: The record ID for loaning a digital record.

materialId.description: The material/item ID for loaning a physical material (Scan & Loan).
The material/item ID for returning a physical material (Scan & Loan).

branchId.description: Branch ID where the physical material is returned.

startTime.description: A wall-clock time in the library’s local timezone (Europe/Copenhagen), without seconds.

endTime.description: A wall-clock time in the library’s local timezone (Europe/Copenhagen), without seconds.

materialType.description: The format of the record: how it is consumed. One value, also where FBI lists several.

name.description: The shelfmark name when searching by author

number.description: The shelfmark number to use for searching

available.description: Whether the material itself can be had now: a copy on the shelf, a free licence, or a link the agency resolves. The patron's own quotas has no impact on this field.

reservable.description: Whether the record can be reserved — a copy held at a branch, or a place in the queue for a digital licence. Decided per record by the agency, not per copy. Web content is never reservable, since a link is neither.

reservations.description: The number of reservations for the record. For digital and online records, this will always be undefined.

availableMaterials.description: The number of available physical materials for the record. This will be 0 for digital and online records.

holdings.description: The physical holding items for the record. This will be empty for digital records.

availableMaterials.description: The number of available physical materials for the branch. This will be 0 for digital and online records.

materials.description: The physical materials for the holding item.

sampleUrl.description: Time-limited signed URL to download the sample. Valid for 7 days, so it should be fetched when needed rather than cached.

periodical.description: Details about the reserved periodical, if the reservation is for a periodical.

expiryInterval.description: The number of days before the reservation expires. Should match one of the values returned by the agency configuration.

periodical.description: If reserving a periodical, enter the volume number and year of the periodical to reserve. Populate both fields if possible.

volume.description: The volume of the periodical to reserve. Only used for when reserving a periodical.

number.description: The volume number of the periodical to reserve.

year.description: The year of the periodical to reserve.

number.description: The shelfmark number to use for searching

hasRecordWithBlueTitle.description: Whether any of the most relevant records of the work is a blue title (`Record.blueTitle`).
